name: Grime Zoo
description: Currently, XXOC's rap is a string consisting of zeroes, ones, and question marks. Unfortunately, haters gonna hate. They will write $$$x$$$ angry comments for every occurrence of subsequence 01 and $$$y$$$ angry comments for every occurrence of subsequence 10 . You should replace all the question marks with 0 or 1 in such a way that the number of angry comments would be as small as possible. String $$$b$$$ is a subsequence of string $$$a$$$, if it can be obtained by removing some characters from $$$a$$$. Two occurrences of a subsequence are considered distinct if sets of positions of remaining characters are distinct.
input_specification: The first line contains string $$$s$$$ — XXOC's rap ($$$1 \le |s| \leq 10^5$$$). The second line contains two integers $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ — the number of angry comments XXOC will recieve for every occurrence of 01 and 10 accordingly ($$$0 \leq x, y \leq 10^6$$$).
output_specification: Output a single integer — the minimum number of angry comments.
approach_summary: Apply Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) paradigm under the Strings framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
